artworks.title: A "Vlotschuit" and a "Schietschuit"
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene with two sailing vessels on the water. The horizon is high in the composition, showcasing the boats and water activity. The etching technique creates detailed texture for clouds, sails, and water. A monochromatic color palette emphasizes contrast and shading. The boats' sails catch a breeze, and clouds fill the sky. Other small vessels can be seen in the distance, adding depth to the seascape.

artworks.title: The Night-Boats to The Hague, Delft, and Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene with buildings, trees, a church spire on the horizon, and boats in the water. The artwork showcases a precise etching style with detailed lines, cross-hatching for shading, and a monochrome color palette of black and white tones. Small boats are visible on the left side of the image under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The "Overtoom" (Portage) at Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a harbor scene. The scene shows a waterfront with various buildings, trees, and people, with a large ship positioned diagonally as the central focus. Workers are seen moving the ship on the shore. In the distance, there is a large water wheel and another boat. Precision line work with hatching and cross-hatching is used for shading and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on paper creating depth. The image conveys activity and labor in a historical seaside town.

artworks.title: The Haarlem "Trekschuiten"
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated position, showing a rural scene across a waterway. The horizon is placed high in the image, emphasizing the activities and objects below it. Several structures, including a windmill, are visible on the horizon. Two sailing ships can be seen in the distance. The image features finely detailed etching with precise lines and hatching techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black. In the foreground, a horse is tethered, and two figures are in conversation. Trees form a natural border on the left, while a boat with people aboard sits along the water's edge on the right.

artworks.title: Winter Scene in the Blockhouses in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene capturing a group of people engaging in various activities on frozen water. In the background, there are buildings, a windmill, and other structures. The artwork is detailed with fine brushstrokes in a monochrome palette, depicting bustling human activity against a serene architectural backdrop.

artworks.title: "Scholshuiten" or "Pinken"
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with sailing ships battling waves. The horizon is low. There is a faint silhouette of a building on the left side. The artwork uses intricate cross-hatching for texture and depth, focusing on the sky and water. The monochromatic color palette plays with light and shadow. The scene is dynamic with waves threatening the ships, under a swirling cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: A Dredger and Mudhoppers
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene by the water. The horizon is high in the composition, with buildings and structures featuring wheel mechanisms. The sky has detailed clouds. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic gray palette with fine lines for textures. A figure rows a boat, other boats are seen with people working. Boats with sails are scattered in the distance.

artworks.title: A Raft and a "Onderlegger"
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a black and white etching of a nautical scene. Various elements are shown, including boats, structures, pots, and barrels. The detailed composition features fine lines suggesting textures of water and wood. The monochromatic palette enhances the historical atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Two "Overlanders" or Houseboats
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two large boats or barges on calm water. The boats are parallel, with a slight angled perspective. The horizon is near the top, where water meets a sky filled with clouds. The etching features detailed hatching and cross-hatching in the sky and water, adding texture. The color palette is mainly shades of gray. Figures on the left boat add scale and human presence.

artworks.title: Portrait of a French Naval Officer
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated individual from the waist up. The person is sitting in a relaxed manner with one arm resting on a surface next to them and the other hand on their lap. The individual has a calm expression with light-colored eyes and a clean-shaven face. They are wearing a dark cap, a formal maritime uniform, and white trousers. The background features an elaborate painting or photograph of a large ship with sails unfurled. The scene is framed by an ornate frame with intricate patterns and floral designs.

artworks.title: Imaginary Classical Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white gouache on blue laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a classical landscape with a bird's-eye view perspective. Mountains are visible in the distance, partially obscured by clouds. Cypress trees dot the horizon. The foreground features architectural structures with classical elements and greenery. The painting is detailed, with delicate brushstrokes depicting architecture and nature accurately. The color scheme is primarily sepia and grey, creating a tranquil atmosphere. A path leads through the landscape.

artworks.title: View of Moscow
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a historic cityscape with fortifications, buildings, distant towers, and a horizon in the upper third of the image. A group of people is on a sloped pathway near us, leading down to the fortifications. The walls of the fortress create straight lines drawing the eye into the distance where a river flows through the city crossed by bridges. The image is sepia-toned, emphasizing the architectural features. It balances details of human activity with the grand scale of the cityscape.

artworks.title: Studies of a Bear
artworks.medium: brown wash with blue gouache over black chalk on blue-green laid paper, inlaid in old album page
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Carter Brown IV and Elissa Brown in Memory of J. Carter Brown
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear standing on its hind legs. The bear has its front paws raised. The drawing uses broad strokes to depict the bear's fur and volume, with a limited color palette of brown, black, and lighter tones. The background is muted and textured. The bear's posture and gesture give the scene a dynamic quality. There's a sketch of another animal in the top left, possibly a small dog. The style is energetic and spontaneous, with a focus on essence rather than detailed realism.

artworks.title: Planche I – Le Maçon Accroupi (Plate I – The Crouching Mason)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a man crouching, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, long-sleeved shirt and trousers. In the background are wooden panels or artworks leaning against a dark wall, in a dimly lit environment.

artworks.title: Planche II – Deux Arlesiennes Dans le Cloître de Saint-Trophime d'Arles (Plate II – Two Arlesiennes in the Cloister of Saint-Trophime of Arles)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a historic architectural setting. The woman on the left is sitting on a stone step with her hands in her lap, while the woman on the right is standing, holding an object with both hands and looking towards the seated woman. Both women are captured in full view. The seated woman has her hair tied back with a head covering, and her facial features are captured in profile as she looks slightly downward. She is wearing a dark dress with a white apron and a shawl. The standing woman also has her hair styled back with a head covering and is dressed similarly in a full skirt with a light apron and shawl, holding an item in her hand. The background consists of ancient-looking stone archways and detailed columns. The texture of the stone and columns adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Planche III – Groupe de Trois Pifferari Debout, dans la Cour du 21 Quai Bourbon (Plate III – Group of Three Pifferari Standing, in the Court of 21 Quai Bourbon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, each dressed in traditional, rustic clothing and wearing wide-brimmed hats. The person on the left is playing a wind instrument with a determined expression. The person in the middle is also playing a wind instrument, with their face partially obscured by shadows. The person on the right, possibly a child, is playing a small wind instrument. The background is a simple wall with a deep shadow cast across it, indicating bright sunlight from the side. No additional objects or jewelry are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Planche IV – Pifferaro Debout et Paysanne Italienne Assise, dans la Cour du 21 Quai Bourbon (Plate IV – Pifferaro Standing and Italian Peasant Seated, in the Court of 21 Quai Bourbon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows two people interacting in front of a building. One individual is seated near the entrance, while the other stands in front of them. The seated person has long hair partly covered with a headscarf and wears a long dress with patterns. The standing person wears a wide-brimmed hat, a coat, trousers tucked into boots, and holds a bag out towards the seated person. The background includes a textured wall, a dark doorway, cobblestone pavement, a pipe on the left, and minimal vegetation.

artworks.title: Planche V – Place du Châtelet (Plate V – Place du Châtelet)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a cobblestone square at street level. In the center is a tall column topped with a statue of a figure holding an object. Surrounding the square are multistory buildings with various architectural details such as chimneys and decorative moldings. The sky above shows fluffy clouds. The color palette is primarily grayscale, emphasizing light and shadow. The cobblestones in the foreground stand out, offering a tactile quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Planche VI – Portail de Saint-Trophime d'Arles (Plate VI – Entrance of Saint Trophime of Arles)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the ornate entrance to a stone building. The image captures the details of a Romanesque-style archway and facade. The central feature is an arched doorway bordered by columns and adorned with carved figures. Above the door, there is a semicircular tympanum containing a relief sculpture, featuring a central figure flanked by other smaller figures. The stone facade is textured and weathered, showcasing layers of historical architecture with decorative columns and figures carved into the stone. Staircases lead up to the door, emphasizing the grandeur of the entrance. The image is monochromatic, highlighting the architectural details and shadows.

artworks.title: Planche VII – Le Louvre, Pavillon de l'Horloge (Plate VII – The Louvre, Pavilion of the Clock)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a grand architectural structure featuring a detailed facade. The building has multiple arches, sculptural details, and ornate window frames. There is a large arched doorway at the center, flanked by columns, leading to a domed roof with decorative statues. The building is adorned with intricate carvings. The color palette consists of sepia tones and grayscale. The sky above has light gray hues and subtle white clouds.

artworks.title: Planche VIII – Portrait de Théophile Gautier, d'après Nadar (Plate VIII – Portrait of Théophile Gautier, by Nadar)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a three-quarter view from the waist up. He has a full beard and mustache and medium-length hair. He is wearing a cap, a dark cloak or coat, and a lighter-colored shirt visible at the collar. The background is plain, possibly a textured surface. The man is not wearing any visible objects or jewelry.

artworks.title: Planche IX – Portrait de Jules Janin, d'après Nadar  (Plate IX – Portrait of Jules Janin, by Nadar)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a man's portrait from the waist up. He is slightly turned to the side, facing forward with a direct gaze. He has a broad face, sideburns, and thinning hair on top. His dark hair is combed back on the sides. The man wears a formal dark suit with a waistcoat and a high-collared white shirt. The background is a plain, dark, gradient backdrop with no discernible features.

artworks.title: Planche X – Portrait du Prince Adam Georges Czartorisky, d'après Nadar (Plate X – Portrait of Prince Adam Georges Czartorisky, by Nadar)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man's upper body in a seated position. He is turned slightly to the side, with his head facing forward. His facial features include a pronounced brow, a slightly prominent nose, and a deeply lined face. His hair is sparse and cropped short. He is wearing a dark, heavy overcoat with several buttons visible on the front. The man's hands are partially visible, appearing to be resting one over the other. The image has a vintage sepia tone, and the background is a plain, textured surface. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man, and the background lacks any specific details or elements.

artworks.title: Planche XI – Le Bûcheron (Plate XI – The Woodcutter)
artworks.artist: Charles Nègre, Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, André Jammes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene with dense trees filling the frame. The artwork features sketch-like brushstrokes creating a textured and fluid motion. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. There is a heavily shaded area at the base of the trees leading towards a winding path or stream. In the distance, a figure appears to move through the trees. The background fades towards an implied light source, possibly an open sky or clearing.
